text:
Anya M: Heads up — customers received duplicate enablement surveys last night. Several mid-market cohorts got two emails 3 hours apart. Seeing renewal-risk churn alerts spike.
Tom S: Thanks, I noticed a surge in `enablement.surveys.sent` in telemetry. Looks like playbook 'enablement-send-v2' executed twice for the same cohort id due to a scheduled overlap.
Vivian K: We had a calendar bump: the new cron schedule was set to both UTC and local cron in the same env after the deploy. Ops accidentally kept old schedule active.
playbook-bot: playbook "enablement-send-v2" executed 2025-12-01T01:02Z (cohort=mm-q4-a)
playbook-bot: playbook "enablement-send-v2" executed 2025-12-01T04:05Z (cohort=mm-q4-a)
Anya M: Oof. Customers replied confused. A few owners reported healthscore dips after the second email (engagement_count doubled for some).
Tom S: Quick mitigation: disable scheduled job in prod, add dedupe by message_id at send-time, and compute engagement deltas based on unique event_ids.
Vivian K: SQL to find affected accounts:
```
SELECT c.id, c.company, COUNT(es.id) AS sends
FROM email_sends es
JOIN accounts c ON c.id = es.account_id
WHERE es.template = 'enablement_survey_v2' AND es.sent_at > now() - interval '48 hours'
GROUP BY c.id
HAVING COUNT(es.id) > 1
LIMIT 200;
```
Anya M: We'll run a soft remediation: mark duplicate sends as 'suppressed' in the send log and re-evaluate healthscore using unique sends only. Avoid altering engagement_count directly.
Tom S: I'll open PR to add idempotency token on playbook invocation and a short-circuit if token seen in last 24h. Also add metric cs.playbook.enablement.dedupe_blocked.
Vivian K: Ops: please run a staging dry-run that flags duplicates and emits expected health deltas before we touch prod.
ops-bot: scheduled job 'staging-enablement-dedupe-check-1829007777' queued for 2025-12-01T09:30Z.
Anya M: Also need a CS owner-facing note: explain duplicate mailings and that we'll suppress duplicates and re-evaluate renewal signals. I'll draft and share.
Tom S: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playbooks/pull/601 (idempotent-token + dedupe guard). Added unit test for double-schedule.
Vivian K: After staging check: 312 affected accounts, median healthscore delta -0.04 when dedupe applied. No other anomalies.
Anya M: OK schedule disabling completed, PR merged to main, will rollout with canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 6h. Monitor cs.playbook.enablement.dedupe_blocked and renewal-alerts.count.
Tom S: Recommend sending one-off apology + clarification to owners for impacted accounts; include link to sanitized sample logs.
Anya M: Drafted note and will send after canary passes. Thanks team for quick triage :heart:
